issues.problem: adabdha = unharmed (English "unharmed", and unit 6 Hindi अहिंसित); अविनाशी (imperishable) is a different sense.

issues.where: of our child, of our offspring, of our selves
issues.problem: tane is labelled dat. but all three are rendered as genitives; Hindi renders tanūnām as शरीरों (bodies), English as "selves", gloss says both. The three do not agree.
issues.fix: pick one rendering of tanū- for English, Hindi and gloss, and state the case of tane in the note

issues.problem: Glossary: stoma = praise (स्तोम); stomaiḥ is rendered "with praises" in English.
issues.fix: हम निम्नतर सहस्थान में स्तोमों से उपासना करें

issues.problem: tam (m. acc.) can equally refer to Agni ("I worship you"); the draft fixes it to the source (yoni) without saying the alternative.
issues.fix: add the alternative to the note

patch.text: tam is masculine accusative and could also be Agni himself ('I worship him'); the translation takes it as the source (yoni).

issues.problem: yajīyān is a comparative ("better at worshipping"); Hindi adds "बनकर" and श्रेष्ठ; the English "best" and the gram "compar." disagree. No patch: needs a decision.
issues.fix: as the better worshipper (and Hindi श्रेष्ठतर)

issues.problem: rayi-patiḥ rayīṇām is rendered with "wealth" and "riches" for the same word rayi, a doubling in English and Hindi (धनपति ... धनों).
"अपने" is not in the text (jaritāram only).

Sandhi does not fit: saḥ + inaḥ + anīkena would give sa ino 'nīkena. The printed sainānīkena (ai ... ā) points to sa + ena(ā) + anīkena (a+e = ai; ā+a = ā), "he, with this host". "inaḥ" (mighty one) is invented; the English and Hindi "the mighty one / शक्तिशाली" rest on it. No patch because the replacement form (ena / enā) needs a decision.
issues.fix: saḥ [he] + enā [with this, inst. pron.] + anīkena [with the host]; English "He, with this host"; Hindi "वह इस सेना के साथ"

issues.problem: Hindi supplies a copula "है" that English does not and the note does not mention (svasti has no verb).
issues.fix: ... सर्वश्रेष्ठ यजन करने वाला; कल्याण के लिए।

summary: Reviewed 6 units. Error: unit 6 split (saḥ + inaḥ + anīkena does not match the printed sainānīkena; expect saḥ + ena/enā + anīkena) with invented 'mighty one'. Minor: glossary deviations (dūta = messenger, vasyas = better fortune, stoma/havis in Hindi), small Hindi additions (ही, अपने, बनकर), unit 4 doubling of rayi. No regrouping suggested.
